benefits.name: Cellular Telephone Protection
benefits.description: Up to $600 of cell phone protection against damage or theft when the monthly cell phone bill is paid with the card.
benefits.terms: Up to $600 per approved claim, subject to a $25 deductible; maximum two paid claims per 12-month period. Cell phone bill must be paid with the card.

benefits.name: Auto Rental Collision Damage Waiver
benefits.description: Secondary reimbursement for covered damage or theft of a rental car paid for with the card.
benefits.terms: Secondary coverage. Pay for the rental with the card and decline the rental company's collision coverage. Other restrictions and limitations apply (see the Wells Fargo Guide to Benefits).

benefits.name: Travel and Emergency Assistance
benefits.description: Assistance and referral services while traveling.
benefits.terms: Assistance and referral only; the cardholder is responsible for the cost of any actual services provided.

benefits.name: Roadside Dispatch
benefits.description: 24/7 roadside dispatch service (e.g. towing) with no membership required.
benefits.terms: Pay-per-use; the cardholder pays for the dispatched service.

benefits.name: Emergency Cash and Card Replacement
benefits.description: Emergency cash disbursement or a replacement card, typically within one to three business days after approval.
benefits.terms: Emergency cash is a cash advance; standard cash advance fees apply.

benefits.name: Visa Signature Concierge
benefits.description: Complimentary 24/7 Visa Signature Concierge for event tickets, travel booking, and dinner reservations.

benefits.name: Visa Signature Luxury Hotel Collection
benefits.description: Premium benefits when booking stays at select properties in the Visa Signature Luxury Hotel Collection.
benefits.terms: Some restrictions and limitations may apply.

earningRates.terms: Unlimited 3X Wells Fargo Rewards points on restaurants, travel, gas, transit, popular streaming services, and phone plans.
